channel.title: Sheaf: PDF Reader
channel.description: Updates for Sheaf: PDF Reader for Mac.

item.title: Sheaf 0.9.5
item.description:
Steadier, with more you can do.

  • The page no longer jumps after you redact, blur or move things on it.
  • Blur as well as Redact, for text and pictures.
  • Fill for boxes and ovals, plus Bring to Front and Send to Back from the right-click menu.
  • Sticky notes that look like notes.
  • The Format panel fits the window and opens by itself when you pick a tool.
  • Any Mac font when adding or editing text, with bold, italic and colour.
  • Built-in AI with nothing to set up (your own key still works).
  • Sheaf now works with CoBuild for Claude.
  • One slim header row, remove files from Recent, set Sheaf as your default PDF app, smoother scrolling.

item.title: Sheaf 0.9
item.description:
The first public beta of Sheaf: PDF Reader.

  • Free to read, for good. Sheaf Pro (editing, annotating, signing, page tools, OCR and AI) is free for 14 days, then US$20 a year or included in CoBuild Pro.
  • Page thumbnails now show everything you add (text, pictures, stamps, highlights).
  • Read aloud sounds natural: it reads sentence by sentence, highlights as it goes and uses the best voice on your Mac.
  • Updates now install from inside the app.
